mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns despite UNRATE crossing above 4% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over 20d horizon despite both proxies above 12-month avg.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, persistent low federal funds rates fail to sustain market optimism, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive in 60d during late-cycle expansion despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor demand (PAYEMS) indicates strong job market conditions, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in 5d despite PAYEMS increasing for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in CPIAUCSL above 2% signals tight monetary policy, raising borrowing costs and dampening equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive in 20d when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in demand (GDPC1) and labor demand (PAYEMS) creates a virtuous cycle of corporate investment and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over 60d horizon despite both proxies above 12-month avg.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery phase, rising demand (GDPC1) reflects renewed economic activity, fostering optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in 5d during post-shock recovery despite GDPC1 rising for 2 consecutive months.
